result:
Clean lint across the whole project, type checking passes, and all 617 existing tests still pass. The implementation is complete:

- **`src/schemas/project.ts`** — added `cloneProjectSchema` / `CloneProjectInput`.
- **`src/types/event.ts`** — added `project.cloned` to `TaskflowEventMap`.
- **`src/schemas/activity.ts`** / **`src/types/activity.ts`** — added `project.cloned` to the audit-action vocabulary (zod schema + type).
- **`src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`** — added the display label the exhaustive `Record<ActivityAction, string>` required.
- **`src/server/services/project-service.ts`** — added `cloneProject`: gates (read source, create on org, source live, project quota, then the whole-batch per-project issue quota) all checked before any write, creates the new project (name/slug/key from the caller, description/visibility/colour/lead from the source, no dates, active), copies live issues renumbered from 1 with status/assignee/timestamps reset and labels kept, and emits exactly one `project.cloned` event.
- **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`** — added `listLiveIssuesForProject` (unpaginated, ordered by number) and `cloneIssuesToProject` (resets progress fields, keeps labels).
- **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`** — records the `project.cloned` audit entry under the new project with `{ sourceProjectId, issuesCopied }`.
- **`src/server/services/usage-service.ts`** / **`src/server/services/search-service.ts`** — subscribe to `project.cloned` to recompute usage and index the clone/its issues synchronously (since `project.created`/`issue.created` aren't emitted for a clone), matching the ADR's "at once" requirement.

No existing tests needed changes — none encoded behavior this altered.
